# Config: Compositor.niri

> **Reader:** `CompositorConfig` (`config/CompositorConfig.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.Compositor` · category Compositor
> **Part of:** [Compositor](Compositor.md)

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.

### `Compositor.niri`

- **`Compositor.niri`** · object
  - niri: niri's own options, written while axiom manages its config. Anything else goes in ~/.config/niri/user/.
  - x-scope="personal", x-showIf={"/$compositor":"niri","/Compositor.mode":"managed"}
- **`Compositor.niri.centerFocusedColumn`** · string = "never" · enum never|always|on-overflow
  - Center the focused column
  - x-compositor={"niri":{"key":"layout.center-focused-column"}}
  - read: `NiriConfig.options` (whole) · in: `config/NiriConfig.qml`
- **`Compositor.niri.alwaysCenterSingleColumn`** · boolean = false
  - Center a lone column: A column alone on its workspace sits in the middle.
  - x-compositor={"niri":{"key":"layout.always-center-single-column","value":"flag"}}
  - read: `NiriConfig.options` (whole) · in: `config/NiriConfig.qml`
- **`Compositor.niri.emptyWorkspaceAboveFirst`** · boolean = false
  - Empty workspace above the first: Keeps an empty workspace above the first one, as well as below the last.
  - x-compositor={"niri":{"key":"layout.empty-workspace-above-first","value":"flag"}}
  - read: `NiriConfig.options` (whole) · in: `config/NiriConfig.qml`
- **`Compositor.niri.defaultColumnDisplay`** · string = "normal" · enum normal|tabbed
  - New columns show
  - x-scope="look", x-compositor={"niri":{"key":"layout.default-column-display"}}
  - read: `NiriConfig.options` (whole) · in: `config/NiriConfig.qml`
- **`Compositor.niri.preferNoCsd`** · boolean = false
  - No title bars on windows: Asks apps to leave out their own title bar (with its close and maximize buttons) and window shadow. Apps that don't agree keep theirs; open ones change once restarted.
  - x-compositor={"niri":{"key":"prefer-no-csd","value":"flag"}}
  - read: `NiriConfig.options` (whole) · in: `config/NiriConfig.qml`
- **`Compositor.niri.hotCorner`** · boolean = false
  - Top-left corner opens niri's overview: Pushing the cursor into the top-left corner opens niri's own overview.
  - x-compositor={"niri":{"key":"gestures.hot-corners.off","value":"offFlag"}}
  - read: `NiriConfig.options` (whole) · in: `config/NiriConfig.qml`
- **`Compositor.niri.overviewZoom`** · integer = 50 · 10–75 · %
  - Overview zoom: How large workspaces show in niri's overview.
  - x-scope="look", x-compositor={"niri":{"key":"overview.zoom","scale":0.01,"value":"float"}}
  - read: `NiriConfig.options` (whole) · in: `config/NiriConfig.qml`
- **`Compositor.niri.animations`** · boolean = true
  - Animations
  - x-scope="look", x-compositor={"niri":{"key":"animations.off","value":"offFlag"}}
  - read: `NiriConfig.options` (whole) · in: `services/compositor/CompositorConfigManager.qml`
- **`Compositor.niri.animationSlowdown`** · integer = 100 · 10–1000 · %
  - Animation length: 100 is niri's own speed; more is slower.
  - x-scope="look", x-showIf={"animations":true}, x-compositor={"niri":{"key":"animations.slowdown","scale":0.01,"value":"float","sk…
  - read: `NiriConfig.options` (whole) · in: `config/NiriConfig.qml`
- **`Compositor.niri.skipHotkeyOverlay`** · boolean = true
  - Skip the hotkey help at start: niri's list of important keys shows when it starts; axiom's binds aren't niri's.
  - x-compositor={"niri":{"key":"hotkey-overlay.skip-at-startup","value":"flag"}}
  - read: `NiriConfig.options` (whole) · in: `config/NiriConfig.qml`
- **`Compositor.niri.primaryClipboard`** · boolean = true
  - Middle-click paste: Selected text pastes with the middle mouse button.
  - x-compositor={"niri":{"key":"clipboard.disable-primary","value":"offFlag"}}
  - read: `NiriConfig.options` (whole) · in: `config/NiriConfig.qml`
- **`Compositor.niri.xwayland`** · boolean = true
  - X11 apps (xwayland-satellite): Runs X11 apps through xwayland-satellite, when it's installed.
  - x-scope="machine", x-compositor={"niri":{"key":"xwayland-satellite.off","value":"offFlag"}}
  - read: `NiriConfig.options` (whole) · in: `config/NiriConfig.qml`
